description: Fetch the full structured content of a single Medium article by URL. Returns title, subtitle, author, publication, publish dates, reading time, clap/response counts, tags, preview image, and body text/HTML. Pass --include-responses true to also load the article's responses (Medium's comments, each itself a short post) via Medium's PagedThreadedPostResponsesQuery GraphQL endpoint. Pass --expand-responses true for contract compatibility; it has no effect because the GraphQL endpoint already returns full response bodies. Data is extracted from the page's embedded Apollo state. Member-only articles return their free preview with isMemberOnly=true. No login required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full Medium article URL. Both forms are supported: https://medium.com/@<user>/<slug>-<postId> (personal) and https://medium.com/<publication>/<slug>-<postId> (publication). The postId is the 12-character hexadecimal string at the end of the URL.

parameters.name: include_responses
parameters.description: Set to true to also return the article's responses. Default false. Responses are loaded via Medium's PagedThreadedPostResponsesQuery GraphQL endpoint.

parameters.name: responses_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of responses to return (1-200, default 50). Only used when include_responses is true.

parameters.name: expand_responses
parameters.description: Accepted for contract compatibility but has no effect. The GraphQL endpoint already returns the full response body, so no additional expansion is required. Only used when include_responses is true. Default false.
